list.title: Buildings
list.description: Each building has its own billing cycle, payee account and prices.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.description: An archived building leaves the building selector and can no longer be edited. Only buildings without active contracts can be archived.
archive.blocked: Cannot archive: these rooms still have active contracts.
archive.blockedUnknown: Some rooms still have active contracts.

form.newDescription: The building code is used in invoice codes, e.g. A-202611-001.
form.editDescription: Building details, its own billing cycle and payee account.
form.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
form.archivedNotice: This building is archived and can no longer be edited.
form.codeLocked: The building has invoices, so its code cannot change.
form.codeFormat: Use only A–Z and 0–9, at most 6 characters.
form.name: Building name
form.billingDescription: Keep "System setting" to use Settings → Billing cycle.
form.bankDescription: Tenants scan the VietQR code on invoices to pay into this account.
form.bankPlaceholder: Search by bank name or code
form.bankAccountNameHint: Upper case without diacritics, as printed on the bank card.
form.bankIncomplete: Enter the bank, account number and account holder together.
form.accountFormat: The account number has 4–19 digits or letters.
form.qrHint: Scan it with a banking app to check the account holder. No need to pay.
form.qrEmpty: Choose a bank and enter the account number to preview a 10,000 ₫ test VietQR code.

prices.title: Building prices
prices.description: {{name}} (code {{code}}): building prices apply from a date; without one, the default price applies.
prices.archivedNotice: This building is archived; its prices cannot change.
prices.noHistory: No building price yet; the default price applies.
prices.rule: The price on a date is the building price with the latest effective date on or before it. Issued invoices do not change.
prices.pastDate: The effective date is in the past: only invoices not yet issued are affected.
prices.priceInteger: The price must be a whole number.
prices.priceRange: The price must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000 ₫.
prices.resetDone: {{name}} returns to the default price from {{date}}.
